if i understood correctly you applied online but one document is missing. did they give you the 45 days deadline to hand in the missing document? if you dont hand it on or ask them  to extend the 45 days your case will be closed. 
in any case it will be difficult to leave and come back in this situation, i do not recommend it. usually they can issue a re-entry visa for the tourist visa, but this only if you are still in the process and also then they can refuse.
